why: Qwen3.5 and models built on it (Ornith among them) ship a chat template that raises an error on a system message after the first turn.

chat_template_fixes.contains: System message must be at the beginning
chat_template_fixes.why: This model's bundled template crashes if a system-role message isn't first in the conversation, which agent harnesses like Coder Agents send. The patched copy drops a misplaced system message instead.
